update coop_invite set deposit_refund_state='PENDING', deposit_refund_no=#{refundNo}, deposit_refund_amount=deposit_amount, deposit_refund_requested_at=now(), update_time=now() where id=#{id} and del_flag=0 and invite_type != 2 and deposit_status=2 and deposit_refund_state is null and deposit_out_trade_no=#{outTradeNo} and deposit_amount=#{amount} and deposit_amount > 0 and (deposit_refund_no is null or deposit_refund_no=#{refundNo})

update coop_invite set deposit_refund_lease_token=#{token}, deposit_refund_lease_at=now(), deposit_refund_state=case when deposit_status=4 and deposit_refund_state is null then 'LEGACY_UNCONFIRMED' when deposit_refund_state='PENDING' then 'DISPATCHING' else deposit_refund_state end where id=#{id} and invite_type != 2 and deposit_status in (2,4) and (deposit_refund_state in ('PENDING','DISPATCHING','PROCESSING','UNKNOWN','LEGACY_UNCONFIRMED') or (#{force} and deposit_refund_state='MANUAL') or (deposit_status=4 and deposit_refund_state is null)) and (deposit_refund_lease_token is null or deposit_refund_lease_at < date_sub(now(),interval 30 minute)) and (#{force} or deposit_refund_state='PENDING' or deposit_refund_lease_at is null or deposit_refund_lease_at < date_sub(now(),interval 30 minute))
update coop_invite set deposit_refund_lease_at=now() where id=#{id} and deposit_refund_lease_token=#{token} and deposit_status=2 and deposit_refund_state in ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN')

update coop_invite set deposit_refund_state=#{state},deposit_refund_lease_token=null, deposit_refund_lease_at=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{id} and deposit_refund_lease_token=#{token} and deposit_status in (2,4) and deposit_refund_state != 'SUCCESS'
